purpose: Turn the Drive-only writer executor into negative regression tests for the current Safe-Effect/Clay execution boundary without duplicating generic historical weak-sandbox credit.

oracles.name: declared_network_deny_must_be_enforced
oracles.historical_failure: SandboxExecutor stores allow_network=false but never applies it to subprocess execution.
oracles.required_pass: With network permission absent, deterministic network probes are denied at the runtime/effect boundary and the receipt records the denial.

oracles.name: sandbox_child_environment_is_allowlisted
oracles.historical_failure: Executed code inherits the complete parent os.environ.
oracles.required_pass: Sandbox execution starts from an explicit environment allowlist; synthetic secret canaries present in the parent environment are absent from child code unless explicitly delegated.

oracles.name: temporary_cwd_is_not_filesystem_isolation
oracles.historical_failure: Execution uses a temporary cwd but establishes no filesystem namespace/chroot/container or equivalent mediated file-effect boundary.
oracles.required_pass: Unauthorized reads/writes outside delegated resources fail regardless of cwd; resource identities and effect grants are explicit.

oracles.name: shell_language_does_not_bypass_effect_authority
oracles.historical_failure: bash/sh are accepted as execution languages under the parent user's permissions.
oracles.required_pass: Shell syntax cannot create destructive-equivalent filesystem/process/network effects outside the same typed Safe-Effect authority contract used by other languages.

oracles.name: compile_is_not_execute
oracles.historical_failure: The rust path invokes rustc on the source and returns the compiler process result without launching the produced program.
oracles.required_pass: Execution receipts explicitly separate compile, launch and runtime phases; a compile-only result cannot satisfy an execute request.
